1) 从告警标签取实例地址，先 ping/ssh 确认机器存活；2) 到该节点确: 1) Take the instance address from the alert labels and first confirm the machine is alive with ping/ssh; 2) On that node confirm the process is running and check the log for a panic or OOM; 3) If the process is alive but the probe fails, check the listening port and firewall; 4) Run tiup cluster display <cluster> for the overall topology state and confirm the remaining nodes still form a majority.
1) 在 PD 节点用 iostat -x 1 确认磁盘 util 与 awai: 1) On the PD node run iostat -x 1 to check disk util and await — PD requires SSDs; 2) Confirm the PD data directory does not share a disk with TiKV data; 3) Check whether another process is competing for that disk's IO; 4) If disk performance is genuinely insufficient, moving PD to a dedicated SSD is the only real fix.
1) 在 PD 节点间用 mtr 确认延迟与丢包出现在哪一跳；2) 确认 PD: 1) Run mtr between PD nodes to find where latency and loss appear; 2) Confirm PD nodes are not spread across data centres — PD is very sensitive to network latency and should be co-located; 3) Check the NIC for errors and drops and whether bandwidth is saturated; 4) Involve the network team, and avoid large data migrations meanwhile.
1) 查 tidb-server 日志搜 critical error 与 bi: 1) Search the tidb-server log for critical error and binlog entries to confirm what was skipped and the scope; 2) Check whether pump/drainer are available — failure to write binlog is the most common cause; 3) Confirm whether downstream data is already missing and use tooling to verify and backfill if needed; 4) After fixing the binlog path, keep watching to confirm nothing else is skipped.
1) 查 tikv 日志尾部与 dmesg -T | grep -i 'kill: 1) Check the tail of the tikv log and dmesg -T | grep -i 'killed process' to tell a crash, an OOM kill and a manual restart apart; 2) For OOM, compare block-cache-size against machine memory; 3) For a panic, collect the logs and check the known issues for your TiDB version; 4) After the restart, run pd-ctl store to confirm the store is Up and regions have rebalanced.
1) 查该 tidb-server 的日志搜 schema lease 相关报错: 1) Search that tidb-server's log for schema lease errors; 2) The usual root causes are an unstable network to PD/TiKV, or GC pressure preventing lease renewal; 3) Check whether a long-running large transaction is blocking schema changes; 4) For a single-instance problem, drain traffic and restart that instance; for a cluster-wide problem, investigate PD and the network.
1) 查该实例日志确认失败的具体报错；2) 排查到 PD/TiKV 的网络连通性: 1) Check that instance's log for the specific failure; 2) Investigate connectivity and latency to PD/TiKV; 3) Check whether a DDL is stuck (ADMIN SHOW DDL JOBS) and blocking schema version advancement; 4) Cancel stuck DDL with ADMIN CANCEL DDL JOBS and redo it.
1) 用 TiDB 慢日志与 Grafana 的 TiKV Coprocesso: 1) Use the TiDB slow log and the Grafana TiKV Coprocessor panel to find SQL doing very large range scans; 2) KILL that query to stop the bleeding if needed; 3) Check whether block-cache-size exceeds a sensible share of physical memory (45% is the usual ceiling); 4) If the instance just started, this may be normal warm-up — but confirm it levels off.
1) 用 df -h 与 du -x --max-depth=1 定位占用最大的: 1) Use df -h and du -x --max-depth=1 to find the largest directories; 2) On TiDB nodes it is usually logs and slow logs piling up — clean those first; 3) For a full TiKV data disk, expand or add nodes and confirm GC is running; 4) Use lsof +L1 to check for deleted files whose handles are still open.
1) 用 df -i 确认是哪个挂载点；2) 逐层统计文件数找出小文件最多的目录: 1) Run df -i to find the mount point; 2) Count files level by level to find the directories with the most small files; 3) In TiDB deployments it is usually unrotated log files — clean the old ones first; 4) Longer term, tune log retention or raise inode density at format time.
1) 用 dmesg -T | grep -iE 'i/o error|remo: 1) Run dmesg -T | grep -iE 'i/o error|remount|read-only' to confirm what triggered it; 2) Run smartctl -a /dev/sdX to check disk health — it is usually bad sectors; 3) Immediately take the services on that node out (pd-ctl store delete or remove it with tiup) so nothing keeps trying to write; 4) After replacing the disk, rejoin the cluster and wait for data to backfill.
1) 用 ip -s link show \u003c网卡\u003e 与 et: 1) Run ip -s link show <nic> and ethtool -S <nic> to confirm the drop counters and the reason; 2) If ring buffers are too small, raise them with ethtool -G <nic> rx; 3) Check whether bandwidth is saturated — large-scale region migration will saturate a NIC; 4) If needed, lower the scheduling concurrency with pd-ctl (leader-schedule-limit, region-schedule-limit).

1) Run ip -s link show <nic> and ethtool -S <nic> to confirm transmit-side drops; 2) Raise txqueuelen and the transmit queue; 3) Check whether bandwidth is saturated and lower PD scheduling concurrency if so; 4) Investigate the NIC driver and the peer switch port state.
1) 用 pd-ctl member 查看各 PD 成员状态，确认存活节点是否已: 1) Run pd-ctl member to check each PD member's state and whether the surviving nodes still form a majority; 2) Without a majority, restore the failed PD nodes immediately; 3) If all nodes are alive but no leader is elected, check connectivity and clock skew between PDs; 4) Check each PD's log for the election failure reason and follow the official PD recovery procedure if needed.
1) 用 pd-ctl store 看各 store 的容量与使用率，确认是个别: 1) Run pd-ctl store to see each store's capacity and usage and whether it is isolated or widespread; 2) For a single full node, check whether regions are unevenly distributed and adjust scheduling with pd-ctl; 3) If it is widespread, you must add TiKV nodes; 4) Confirm GC is running normally (a GC life time set too long lets old versions accumulate).
1) 用 pd-ctl store 确认是哪个 store、down 了多久；2: 1) Run pd-ctl store to identify the store and how long it has been down; 2) On that node check the tikv process and disk state; 3) If it can be recovered quickly, do so — that avoids PD triggering large-scale replica replenishment and extra load; 4) If it genuinely cannot be recovered, run pd-ctl store delete <id> for a graceful decommission so data migrates in an orderly way.
1) 用 ps aux --sort=-%mem | head 确认是哪个进程占: 1) Run ps aux --sort=-%mem | head to find the largest consumer; 2) For high TiKV memory, check block-cache-size first; for high TiDB memory, look for large queries without mem-quota-query; 3) Set tidb_mem_quota_query to cap per-query memory; 4) If there is no leak and it is still short, add memory or move instances.
1) 用 ss -s 看连接状态分布，确认是 ESTABLISHED 还是 TI: 1) Run ss -s to see the connection state distribution and whether ESTABLISHED or TIME_WAIT dominates; 2) Run ss -tan | awk '{print $5}' | cut -d: -f1 | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn to locate the sources; 3) If the application does not reuse connections, switch to a connection pool; 4) If TIME_WAIT dominates, enable tcp_tw_reuse and widen the port range.
1) 用 top -H 定位是 tidb-server、tikv-server: 1) Run top -H to see whether tidb-server, tikv-server or something else is busy; 2) High TiKV CPU usually means too many coprocessor requests — use the TiDB slow log to find SQL scanning large ranges; 3) High TiDB CPU usually means complex computation or many small queries — check the Grafana TiDB Query Summary; 4) If it stays high after SQL tuning, add nodes.
1) 看 Grafana 的 TiDB Query Summary 找 QPS: 1) Check the Grafana TiDB Query Summary for the statement types with the highest QPS and latency; 2) Use the TiDB slow log to find the specific SQL and check for missing indexes causing heavy row lookups; 3) Confirm tidb_server_maxprocs matches the container/machine size; 4) If it stays high after tuning, add tidb-server instances.
Grafana 不可达，监控看板不可用（不影响集群本身，但会影响故障排查效率）。: Grafana is unreachable and the monitoring dashboards are unavailable (this does not affect the cluster itself but does slow down troubleshooting).
PD 实例不可达，若失去多数派则整个集群调度与 TSO 停摆。: A PD instance is unreachable; if the majority is lost, cluster scheduling and TSO allocation stall entirely.
PD 报告有 TiKV store 处于 down 状态，集群冗余下降，PD 会: PD reports a TiKV store is down: cluster redundancy is reduced and PD will start moving replicas to other nodes, with performance impact during the process.
PD 的 WAL fsync P99 延迟超过 1 秒。PD 是集群的调度大脑，: PD WAL fsync P99 latency exceeds 1 second. PD is the cluster's scheduling brain, so slow disk writes cause frequent leader changes and destabilise global scheduling.
PD 节点间网络往返延迟超过 1 秒，会导致 raft 心跳超时与频繁重新选举，: Round-trip latency between PD nodes exceeds 1 second, causing raft heartbeat timeouts and frequent re-elections, which destabilises cluster scheduling.
PD 集群没有 leader，整个 TiDB 集群的调度与 TSO 分配停摆，所: The PD cluster has no leader: scheduling and TSO allocation for the entire TiDB cluster are stalled and every transaction will fail.
TiDB 出现 critical error（含跳过 binlog），下游同步可: TiDB reported a critical error (including skipped binlog): downstream replication may already have lost data — this is a data consistency risk.
TiDB 加载 schema 出现 outdated 错误，说明该实例的元数据版: TiDB reported an outdated schema load error, which means this instance's metadata version is behind and reads/writes after a DDL may fail.
TiDB 频繁加载 schema 失败，元数据无法同步，DDL 与依赖新表结构的: TiDB is repeatedly failing to load schema: metadata cannot sync, and DDL plus any reads/writes depending on the new schema will fail.
TiDB-PD 写盘延迟大于 1s ，leader 写盘慢会导致 leader: TiDB - PD disk write latency exceeds 1s; slow leader writes cause leader switches
TiDB-PD 节点之间网络延迟大于 1s: TiDB - network latency between PD nodes exceeds 1s
TiDB-tidb CPU 使用率超过可用 CPU的 80%: TiDB - tidb CPU usage exceeds 80% of available CPU
TiDB-tidb 最近 15 分钟加载 schema 出现错误: TiDB - tidb schema load errors in the last 15 minutes
TiDB-tidb 最近五分钟出现跳过 binlog: TiDB - tidb skipped binlog in the last 5 minutes
TiDB-tidb 最近十分钟加载 schema 失败大于 10 次: TiDB - tidb schema load failed more than 10 times in the last 10 minutes
TiDB-tikv 5分钟内内存增长大于 5G: TiDB - tikv memory grew more than 5G within 5 minutes
TiDB-集群中出现状态为 down 的 tikv 数量大于 0: TiDB - tikv instances in down state above 0
TiFlash 实例不可达，列存副本不可用，走 TiFlash 的分析型查询会回: A TiFlash instance is unreachable: the columnar replicas are unavailable and analytical queries routed to TiFlash will fall back to TiKV or fail outright.
TiKV 实例不可达，其上的 region 副本失效，集群冗余下降，副本不足时相: A TiKV instance is unreachable: its region replicas are lost, cluster redundancy is reduced, and where replicas fall short the affected data becomes unwritable.
TiKV 实例发生重启，其上的 region leader 需要重新选举，期间相: A TiKV instance restarted: the region leaders on it must be re-elected and the related reads and writes will fail briefly.
TiKV 节点可用空间低于 20%。达到 PD 的 low-space-rati: TiKV node free space is below 20%. Once PD's low-space-ratio is reached, scheduling refuses to place data there, and further decline blocks cluster writes.
TiKV 进程 5 分钟内内存增长超过 5G，可能是有大查询把大量数据加载到内存: The TiKV process grew by more than 5G of memory in 5 minutes, possibly because a large query is loading lots of data into memory; further growth will get it OOM-killed.
blackbox_exporter 不可达，所有基于探测的存活告警都会失效，集群: blackbox_exporter is unreachable: every probe-based liveness alert stops working and the cluster enters a partial monitoring blind spot.
drainer 不可达，binlog 下游同步中断，下游数据会开始落后并可能超出: drainer is unreachable: downstream binlog replication is broken, downstream data will fall behind and may exceed pump's retention window.
node_exporter 不可达，该机器的系统层指标全部缺失，主机层告警会失效: node_exporter is unreachable: all system-level metrics for that machine are missing and host-level alerts stop working.
pump 不可达，binlog 写入中断，可能导致下游同步断档甚至 TiDB 写: pump is unreachable: binlog writes are broken, which can break downstream replication and even block TiDB writes.
tidb-server 实例不可达，SQL 入口中断，连到该实例的业务会全部失败: A tidb-server instance is unreachable: the SQL entry point is down and any workload connected to it will fail.
tidb-server 进程 CPU 使用率超过其可用配额的 80%，SQL 处: The tidb-server process CPU usage is above 80% of its available quota and SQL processing will queue.
文件系统 inode 使用率超过 80%，耗尽后即使有剩余空间也无法创建新文件，: Filesystem inode usage is above 80%; once exhausted, no new file can be created even with free space, presenting as "the disk is not full but writes fail".
文件系统变为只读，通常是磁盘出现硬件错误后内核的保护动作。落在该盘上的 TiKV: The filesystem went read-only, usually the kernel's protective response to a disk hardware error. TiKV/TiDB data on that disk can no longer be written.
磁盘使用率超过 80%，继续增长会触发 PD 的空间保护并最终导致写入失败。: Disk usage is above 80%; further growth triggers PD's space protection and eventually blocks writes.
网卡入方向出现丢包，TiKV/TiDB 之间的 raft 与 coprocess: The NIC is dropping inbound packets: raft and coprocessor traffic between TiKV/TiDB will retransmit and latency jitter becomes noticeable.
网卡出方向出现丢包，节点间通信重传增多，集群整体延迟上升。: The NIC is dropping outbound packets: inter-node retransmits increase and overall cluster latency rises.
节点 CPU 使用率超过 80%，TiDB/TiKV 的请求处理会开始排队，SQ: Node CPU utilization is above 80%: TiDB/TiKV request handling will queue and SQL latency will rise.
节点 TCP 连接数超过 5 万，通常意味着连接泄漏，会耗尽端口与内存。: The node has more than 50,000 TCP connections, which usually means a connection leak and will exhaust ports and memory.
节点内存使用率超过 80%，继续增长会触发 swap 或 OOM，TiKV/Ti: Node memory usage is above 80%; further growth triggers swap or OOM and the TiKV/TiDB processes risk being killed.
通常 tikv 实例刚启动时会触发。或者有较复杂的计算 offload 到 ti: Usually triggered right after a tikv instance starts, or when complex computation offloaded to tikv briefly raises memory; analyze the specific SQL statements.
通常有连接泄露，需分析主要是与哪个对象的连接。: Usually a connection leak; analyze which target holds most of the connections.
集群不可用，可能 pd 多数派故障，需要分析日志查看无法选举 leader 的原: Cluster unavailable, possibly a PD majority failure; analyze the logs to find why a leader cannot be elected.
需要检查 tikv 是否有删除数据但空间未释放的问题，如果是正常的空间使用，则需: Check whether tikv has deleted data whose space was not reclaimed; if the space usage is legitimate, scale out tikv nodes.
